items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: Well, that was my house band, hobby, and they kept the music going steady. And anybody wanted to sit in, these -- all three of these guys could play. Billy Towles could play. So could Earl DeWitt, and so could Joe Dukes.

ctx.x: and he was with the house band, and we had a great bandleader right here in Denver now, Towles. that's like (unintelligible), Billy Tells. He had that band.

We had a great organist named Earl DeWitt. Earl DeWitt right now is in Chicago. Well, that was my house band, hobby, and they kept the music going steady. And anybody wanted to sit in, these -- all three of these guys could play. Billy Towles could play. So could Earl DeWitt, and so could Joe Dukes.
And the musicians would enjoy sitting, you know. Sometimes we'd have nine, 12, you know, on the stand.
